abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. This comparison was run at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 4. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 179 | 800 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 174 | 800 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 203 | 800 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 101 | 800 |

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 9.4 | 4.7 | 800 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 9.5 | 4.8 | 800 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 9.3 | 4.7 | 800 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 6.8 | 3.4 | 800 |

The same layout is used for all arms and measures here.
